text:
support: Heads up — we're getting a spike of 5xx (mostly 503) for hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~2024-04-12 10:12 UTC. Multiple customer escalations (acme-inc, pulseai, beta-app). Gateway shows upstream runner exits and container restarts. Can the oncall/runtime team triage?
alex: Acknowledged. Giving this priority. Can someone paste recent runner logs and any core dumps we have? Any sign of OOM vs segfault?
priya: Pasted quick grep from gateway + runner logs for 10:12..10:20: 
```
runner[pid=2423]: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
runner[pid=2423]: attempting kvcache prefetch size=18446744073709551615 ???
runner[pid=2423]: signal 11 (Segmentation fault) at 0x7f9a3c2b
```
lina: Not seeing a model hot-swap around that time. We rolled an autoscaler batching tweak last night (increase max_batch_capacity) which could change allocation patterns.
jorge: Customer traces show a lot of toolcall prefetch + long contexts. A few requests have huge prompt chunks and toolcall payloads; that would push memory up fast.
support: CS confirms impacted customers; they're seeing 503s and some timeouts in SDKs. CS asked for an ETA.
oncall-bot: Pager acknowledged by alex at 2024-04-12 10:15 UTC.
lina: I'm trying to repro locally with the same model + toolcall combo. Repro notes: 
1) use model vX.2 quantized variant, payload includes toolcall with embedded context ~110k tokens
2) batchsize 24, streaming enabled
3) run prefetch background => OOM in ~15s then SIGSEGV
```bash
# repro-ish
python tools/repro_runner.py --model vX.2 --batch 24 --context-file big_prompt.json --enable-prefetch
```
priya: Could the autoscaler change have allowed larger batches to be formed? Larger effective batch + prefetching = big aggregate GPU alloc. Recommend temporarily lowering max_batch_capacity or add a hard per-request context cap.
alex: Agreed. I'll roll back the autoscaler tweak and apply a per-request max-context guard on gateway for hosted routes (reject > 65536 tokens). @eng-runtime please stand by for a quick rollback.
deploy-bot: Started job rollback-autoscaler-2024-04-11-23:45 (id: j-9832)
jorge: Long-term we should add prefetch memory accounting and conservative kvcache prefetch limits per request. Right now prefetch can request huge contiguous allocations.
support: CS updated: told customers we're investigating; offered temporary routing to Dedicated for high-SLA customers. They asked to be notified when fallbacks are in place.
lina: Mitigation in place: autoscaler change rolled back at 10:28 UTC, gateway max-context=65536 enforced at 10:30 UTC. I'm collecting core dumps + nvml traces and uploading to /srv/diag/1712349876/. Will attach heap snapshots.
priya: Seeing error rate drop in the 10:32 metrics. Need to run a short canary load with large contexts to ensure stability.
alex: Good. Next steps: (1) collect postmortem owners (lina + jorge), (2) surface model/toolcall combos that trigger repro, (3) add per-request accounting + throttles, (4) follow up with CS with timeline.
support: :thumbsup: I'll keep CS looped and escalate billing concerns if customers request credits.
priya: One-off note: some runner log lines show weird prefetch size=18446744073709551615 which suggests underflow/uint wrap in prefetch size calc — please include that in the PM.
lina: Will include. Creating incident artifact and assigning owners now.
alex: Thanks team. Monitoring continues; will post when we confirm fully stable.
